description: This file defines the EmployeeReportController class in the OrangeHRM project, responsible for managing the presentation logic of employee reports within the framework's MVC architecture. It includes methods to prepare data for rendering views related to employee reports, utilizing services and components for dynamic UI rendering.

classes.name: EmployeeReportController
classes.description: Controller class handling employee report views, extending AbstractVueController, responsible for setting up report view components based on incoming HTTP requests.

methods.name: getReportGeneratorService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of ReportGeneratorService used for report data retrieval.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view component before rendering, choosing between report detail view or report list view based on request parameters.
